name: Aard
effect: Telekinetic blast. Target must defend or be knocked back 2m and suffer 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

name: Igni
effect: Cone of flame. 2d6 fire damage; target may catch fire on failed defense.

name: Yrden
effect: Magic trap slows enemies in area; forces spectral foes corporeal.

name: Quen
effect: Absorbs damage from one attack before dissipating.

name: Axii
effect: Stuns target on failed defense; usable in social encounters to influence.

name: Zephyr
effect: Burst of wind blasts targets within 2m back 6m for 1d6 damage; ramming damage on impact.

name: Magic Healing
effect: Heals 3 HP per turn while maintained.

name: Dispel
effect: Ends an active spell or blocks a magical attack (may be used as defensive action).

name: Cadfan's Grasp
effect: Super-heats metal item: holder drops it or takes 2d6 limb damage; or heats weapon for +2d6 and 50% ignite.

name: Carys' Hail
effect: Hail of ice shards strikes a 2m area for 2d6 cold damage per target.

name: Melgar's Fire
effect: Calls fire from the sky on a target for 4d6 fire damage.

name: Rhwystr Graig
effect: Creates a stone wall up to 3m × 2m within range.

name: Teleportation
effect: Instantly move to a known location within line of sight or memory.

name: Dormyn's Blessing
effect: Blessed target gains +2 to Courage and Resist Coercion.

name: Divine Wisdom
effect: +3 to Education, Awareness, and Social Etiquette rolls.

name: Afan's Mirror
effect: Creates illusory duplicates; controlled copies cannot leave spell range.

name: Odi Bywyd
effect: Restores a dying target to 1 HP and stabilizes wounds.

name: Curse of Pain
effect: Target suffers −2 to all actions until hex is removed.

name: Hex of Binding
effect: Target's legs bind; movement halved and cannot run.

name: Stammelford's Arcane Seal
effect: Inscribes a ward on a doorway or object; triggers chosen effect when disturbed.

name: Ritual of Scrying
effect: Observe a person or place you have seen before; requires focus object.

name: Commune with Nature
effect: Learn about flora, fauna, and weather in the surrounding region.

name: Entangling Growth
effect: Vegetation restrains targets in a 3m area; REF defense to avoid.

name: Call Storm
effect: Summons rain and wind; ranged attacks penalized in area.
